title: Manuel Perez's address and Dr. Bechet and his horn
summary: Discussion of where Perez lived, then Dr. Bechet the dentist who loved his horn.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Which street did he live on?

He lived on Praia between St. Antin and Boerbun. It's Pog now but they used to call it Boerbun. You see the street going around, you know, from Boerbun, it's called all of it Boerbun, but they called it Pog in our back then.
I think it is, yeah. When I met him before he died he was on Urquhart I believe. Urquhart?
Robertson, I don't know one of those streets.
I don't know, I don't know because he owned that house on Praia Street I know.
No, this is a different street. He'd moved then.
Is it a two row street?
No, well maybe, maybe with some of his children or maybe…
Runs parallel with Robertson. Yeah. Well maybe so, I don't remember. Right near St. Bernard Circle. Yeah. Down in there.
Towards the river a couple of blocks. Down near where Dr. Bechet lived over in downtown a little bit in there.
Yeah I played some job with him too, Dr. Bechet. Oh yes. He wasn't the best drum horn player but he loved that horn. He sure loved his music.

Oh man, when he didn't have enough patience in his office he'd hear him blowing that horn all day long. And he kept it so beautiful, shine, this is all speak and span, he had a beautiful gold horn. And he kept it speak and span all the time.
